title: 工具使用智能体的可控遗忘：可逆上下文管理实践
summary: 研究智能体可控遗忘机制：模型选择已观察的工具结果，用简短笔记替换并保留原始内容于可恢复存档中。在OpenTelemetry调试案例中，提示词token从912,492降至231,951，输入token减少50%，成本从约4.38美元降至1.28-1.44美元，但请求更多、耗时增加17%。表明在噪声工具轨迹中可显著节省资源，且存在工作负载依赖性。
summary_en: This paper studies agent-controlled forgetting: the acting model selects previously observed tool results, replaces each with a short note while archiving the exact original for recovery. In an OpenTelemetry debugging case, prompt tokens dropped from 912,492 to 231,951, input tokens fell 50%, and cost went from ~$4.38 to $1.28-1.44, though with more requests and 17% longer runtime. Results show substantial savings in noisy tool-use trajectories with workload dependence.
